definitions.short: Nachath , the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5184. Nachath III. נַ֫חַת proper name, masculine 1. son of Reuel, grandson of Esau Gen 36:13 , 17 (P; ᵐ5 Ναχομ , Ναχοθ ᵐ5 L Ναχεθ ), 1Chr 1:37 ( ᵐ5 Ναχες , A ᵐ5 L Ναχεθ ). 2 grandson of Elkanah 1Chr 6:11 , ᵐ5 Καιναθ , ᵐ5 L Νααθ ; — probably corrupt for תּוֺחַ v. 6:19 , or תֹּחוּ 1Sam 1:1 (see these words and We de Gent. 37 f. [who proposes תַּחַת for נַחַת ], Dr 1:1 ). 3 an overseer, Hezekian's time 2Chr 31:13 , ᵐ5 Μαεθ , A Ναεθ , ᵐ5 L Νααθ .

occurrences.englishText: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.
